Exercise: Lower Back Curl

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
None

Force Type:
static

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- flexion_extension

Primary Muscles:

- abdominals

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:

- bodyweight

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
low

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:
None

Contraindications:

- condition: Lower Back Pain, description: This exercise may exacerbate lower back pain. Consult a healthcare professional before attempting.

Exercise Variations:

- name: Reverse Lower Back Curl, instructions: ['Lie on your back with your arms out to your sides. This will be your starting position.', 'Using your lower back muscles, flex your spine lifting your chest towards the ceiling. Do not use your arms to push yourself up. Keep your head down during the movement. Repeat for 10-20 repetitions.']

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Cat-Cow Stretch, equipment: body only

Instructions:

- Lie on your stomach with your arms out to your sides. This will be your starting position.
- Using your lower back muscles, extend your spine lifting your chest off of the ground. Do not use your arms to push yourself up. Keep your head up during the movement. Repeat for 10-20 repetitions.
